scripts.check: pnpm check:eol && pnpm format:check && turbo run typecheck lint && turbo run test --filter=!@yourtal/api --filter=!@yourtal/db --filter=!@yourtal/idempotency --filter=!@yourtal/queue --filter=!@yourtal/media --filter=!@yourtal/ledger-service --filter=!@yourtal/voucher-service --filter=!@yourtal/worker
scripts.//check: The fast gate, under 3 minutes, needing no services: line endings, format, typecheck (incl. go vet), lint, and every unit suite that needs no database. CI's quality.yml runs exactly this.
scripts.verify: pnpm check && turbo run test --filter=@yourtal/api --filter=@yourtal/db --filter=@yourtal/idempotency --filter=@yourtal/queue --filter=@yourtal/media --filter=@yourtal/ledger-service --filter=@yourtal/voucher-service --filter=@yourtal/worker && pnpm policy:test && pnpm --filter @yourtal/web test:rendered
scripts.//verify: check, plus the suites that need the dev stack: each Postgres-backed package, media (MinIO) and both Go services run against their own throwaway yourtal_test_* database (packages/db/scripts/with-test-db.mjs), and the Cerbos policy suite. Needs `pnpm dev:up`.
scripts.dev:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d --wait
scripts.dev:psql: docker exec -it yourtal-postgres psql -U yourtal -d yourtal
scripts.dev:fresh: pnpm dev:reset && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed && pnpm media:publish
